@@y05 trigger fn declared on table, trigger-assign of different-named col via NEW record var copy
CREATE FUNCTION t() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN r := NEW; r.io := NOW(); RETURN r; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER tg BEFORE UPDATE ON aveloxis_data.repos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION t()
@@y06 fk cascade on registered column from create table (control: schema style)

@@y11 insert on conflict do update where guard is merge-style... conflict set through alias column qualified (invalid)
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS r (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, EXCLUDED.fe), io = r.io
@@y12 guard uses alias that is also a FROM subquery alias inside EXISTS
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = $1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s.stg r WHERE r.fe IS NULL) AND TRUE
@@y13 guard IS NULL on target but SET in a different CTE-level update of same table

@@y14 plpgsql guard reads variable (use_variable)
